name: Huttian star yacht
description: A certain type of bell-shaped space yacht was used by the Hutts at some point before the start of the Clone Wars in 22 BBY. Those yachts had big entrance hatches, large enough for a masive Hutt to get in or out. The Huttese criminal Zorba Desilijic Tiure owned one, which he had christened the Zorba Express.
